environment.name: ThrusterChain
environment.import_line: import experiments.shift.thruster_chain  # registers the ids (from the repository root, before import gymnasium)

entries.name: wave, first number (the push it adds now: amplitude x cos(phase))
wave, second number (amplitude x sin(phase), the push the wave added a quarter cycle earlier)

dynamics.formula: s' = A s + 0.3 B thrust(a) + 0.3 v (c + w1);  c' = c;  (w1, w2)' = (w1, w2) turned by 0.27 rad

reward.note: s: the 10 float numbers (float64 state); a: the clipped command; energy is charged on the command even while a thruster stalls

banks.note: the four banks share the seed, so start i of every bank uses the same random draws mapped through different start laws

recording_controller.K_note: command = -(K_floats s + K_water (c, w1, w2)); the textbook optimal linear controller (discounted linear-quadratic regulator, discount 0.98) of the model in which thrust keeps rising with throttle
recording_controller.normal_driving_formula: u = -(0.25 K_floats s + K_water e) + 0.3 n, n ~ N(0, I4); command = 0.8 tanh(u / 0.8)
recording_controller.full_throttle_formula: in the full-throttle region (c + w1 > 0.565), with probability 0.5 per step: command = clip(P + 0.03 n, -1, 1)

reference_returns.note: exact undiscounted 100-step returns, mean over the 1,000 fixed starts of each evaluation bank (truth.bank_rollout: float64 commands through dynamics()); points use each world's own anchors: 0 = recording controller, 100 = stall-aware controller (stalling world) or rising-thrust controller (no-stall comparison world)

env_path_check.how: gym.make('BCAShift/ThrusterChain-StrongCurrent-v0'), reset(options={'state': start}) for each of the 1,000 bank starts, commands rounded to float32 and sent through env.step (the snippet in SHIFT_ENV.md)

design_comparison.summary: every design number matches at its shown precision

live_panel.start_rule: the lowest bank index whose recorded-conditions start spends between 30% and 45% of its 100 steps in the full-throttle region (water's push c + w1 above 0.565); the same index is used in every situation (the banks share their random draws)

fields.states: 101 x 13: the state before each step (row t) and after the last step (row 100), float64 rounded to 4 decimals; the observation is float32 of it
fields.commands: 100 x 4: the applied command (rounded to float32, then clipped), 4 decimals
fields.thrust: 100 x 4: the push each thruster applied (info['thrust'])
fields.running_return: 100: return so far after each step
fields.full_throttle_command: recording controller only, 100: 1 when it gave the full-throttle command

recorded_episode.seed_role: calibration seed (never used by the gate's training runs)
recorded_episode.episode_rule: the lowest-numbered training episode whose first 8 rows hold at least one full-throttle command and at least one normal-driving command

worked_reward_step0.formula: r = -(sum of the 10 squared float numbers + 0.3 x sum of the 4 squared throttles)

replay_check.rule: reset(options={'state'}) + step(action) must reproduce every row bit for bit

design_ranges.source: SHIFT_ENV.md and stage0.COMPUTED (calibration seeds 900-904) and the design record (10 seeds)

design_comparison.note: the design's card used the gap of data seed 0; this one uses calibration seed 900, so small differences are expected

shift_cards.note: shift.shift_card for each reference controller on each bank, stalling world, with the gap and kept rows of calibration seed 900; measures 1-8 of SHIFT_ENV.md

region_pool.note: true price = Q(s, capped pattern) - Q(s, full-throttle pattern), exact 1,000-step discounted value with the named controller continuing; positive means pushing past 80% is worse. Design: 0.355 median (stall-aware, stalling world), -0.009 no-stall

td3_bc.actor_loss: -lambda * mean Q1(s, pi(s)) + mean over rows of [multiplier_i * mean over the 4 throttles of (pi(s_i) - a_i)^2],  lambda = alpha / mean |Q1| (algorithms/td3_bc.py, _actor_loss_fn)
td3_bc.networks: actor 13-256-256-4 ReLU with tanh output; two critics 256-256 ReLU (algorithms/td3_bc.py)

actor_fixed_point.formula: pi = (m a + k c) / (m + k), k = d lambda |H| / 2 (d = 4 throttles); share of the way from the recorded command a toward the critic's best command c is k / (m + k)

bca_dose.formula: dose = 1 + blend * w / (w + u): w = the band width at the row (calibrated threshold x predicted error scale x unit), u = the unit (residual scale); blend 0.5, so doses lie in [1, 1.5) (calibration/dose.py, level_critic_dose)

caution_placements.harm_placed: 1 + 0.5 x / (1 + x), x = 3 D_i / mean(D), D_i the exact over-preference at row i of the arm's current actor, refreshed every 4,000 steps
caution_placements.cap2: 1 + x / (1 + x) (doses up to 2: is the dose cap the limit?)
caution_placements.amount_matched: every row gets the mean harm-placed dose of the same refresh
caution_placements.shuffled: the harm-placed doses permuted by a fixed seeded permutation (two versions)
caution_placements.reversed: the harm-placed doses with their ranks flipped (largest dose on the smallest D_i)
caution_placements.even: every row the same multiplier; ladder x1.1, x1.25, x1.5, x2, x3
caution_placements.strength_matched_even: even caution whose strength S (root-mean-square change of the command from the no-caution arm on 5,000 evaluation-split states) equals the harm-placed arm's; the multiplier is found from strengths alone and locked before any return is computed

power.formula: N = max(10, ceil(((2.128 + 0.842) x 1.25 x s / 3)^2)), s = the larger standard deviation of the two paired differences across the gate seeds (points)

pass_marks.S1: (dict(S0.MARKS, fallback_grid='full-throttle share target {0.12, 0.13} x wobble {0.3, 0.35} x normal-driving damping {0.25, 0.35}, default first; nothing else may be searched'))

mark_text.H1: The critic is wrong where data are missing: with everything else equal, the critic trained on the gapped log is at least twice as wrong (median advantage error) at the removed commands as the critic trained on the full log; no more wrong far from the gap; random removal and another initialisation do not explain it; the stall makes it at least 1.5 times worse than in the no-stall comparison world; and the gapped critic prefers a pull past 80% by at least 25% of its true price more than the full critic does.
mark_text.H2: Acting on that error costs return: from one cloned actor, the actor trained against the gapped critic scores at least 5 points below the one trained against the full critic in strong current, more than random removal and the no-stall comparison world explain, it pushes past 80% at least 1.5 times as often, and the exact step-by-step accounting puts the loss at its past-80% steps: the loss rate there is positive and at least twice the loss rate at its other steps (when the other steps show no loss at all, a rate of zero or a gain, any positive loss rate at the past-80% steps meets this).
mark_text.H3: Room: caution placed by the exact harm, inside BCA's dose range [1, 1.5), beats the same strength of even caution, the same amount of caution and the same doses shuffled, each by at least 3 points.
mark_text.H4: Power: the number of confirmation seeds N from the spread of real co-trained runs must be at most 20.

H1.a: the gapped critic is at least twice as wrong at the removed commands (and 1.5 times in every seed)
H1.b: it is no more wrong far from the gap (ratio within 1/1.5 to 1.5)
H1.c: random removal of the same number of rows does not explain it
H1.d: another initialisation does not explain it, on every pool
H1.e: the stall makes it at least 1.5 times worse than in the no-stall comparison world
H1.f: the gapped critic prefers a pull past 80% more than the full critic, in at least 4 of 5 seeds

H2.a: the gapped critic's actor loses at least 5 points in strong current
H2.b: at least 3 points more than random removal explains
H2.c: at least 3 points more than in the no-stall comparison world
H2.d: it pushes past 80% at least 1.5 times as often
H2.e: the loss sits at its past-80% steps (a positive loss rate there, at least twice the rate of its other steps; met by any positive rate when the other steps lose nothing)

holm_families.about: each family is tested under Holm's correction, a correction for testing several things at once
holm_families.policy_level_1: BCA minus plain TD3+BC on each room-certified shifted situation (one-sided, 0.05)
holm_families.policy_level_2: on each situation that passed level 1: BCA minus flattened, BCA minus shuffled and BCA minus strength-matched even caution, all tests together (one-sided, 0.05)

verdicts.V1: BCA finds the harm, and its caution, placed where it finds it, improves returns out of distribution while still improving on the recording
verdicts.V1_noise_rider: placing the same doses by target noise alone does about as well, so the gain does not show detection of critic error
verdicts.V2: BCA helps out of distribution, but not because of where it places caution
verdicts.V7: BCA helps out of distribution and where it places its caution matters, but its doses do not follow the exact critic error, so the gain is not shown to come from finding the harm
verdicts.V7_recording_rider: it also does not improve on the recording by the required 5 points
verdicts.V8: BCA finds the harm and its caution, placed where it finds it, improves returns out of distribution, but it does not improve on the recording by the required 5 points
verdicts.V3: BCA finds the harm, but its caution is too weak to change returns

gate.verdict_order: The verdict is chosen by the first rule that applies, in this order. 'BCA costs performance' (V5): no loss in recorded conditions (P2) or no harm without the shift (P4) fails, or BCA minus plain TD3+BC is at most -2 points with a 95% upper bound below 0 on a room-certified situation. 'Inconclusive' (V6): the plain run loses less than 3 points to unrecorded throttle on the confirmation seeds, or the 95% interval of a level-1 difference is wider than 5 points either side. 'BCA finds the harm, and its caution ... improves returns out of distribution while still improving on the recording' (V1): the detection marks pass, levels 1 and 2 pass on at least one situation, and P2, P3 and P4 pass. 'BCA helps out of distribution and where it places its caution matters, but its doses do not follow the exact critic error' (V7): levels 1 and 2 pass on at least one situation but the detection marks fail (with the added sentence 'it also does not improve on the recording by the required 5 points' when P3 fails too). 'BCA finds the harm ... but it does not improve on the recording by the required 5 points' (V8): levels 1 and 2 pass on at least one situation and the detection marks pass, but P3 fails. 'BCA helps out of distribution, but not because of where it places caution' (V2): level 1 passes somewhere and level 2 fails on every situation where it passed. 'BCA finds the harm, but its caution is too weak to change returns' (V3): the detection marks pass and level 1 fails everywhere. 'No detectable benefit' (V4): otherwise. The sentence on target noise is added to V1 and V8 when placing the same doses by the noise map scores within 2 points of BCA, or better.

stop_rule.harm: H1 fails, or H2 fails at every alpha of the ladder: run the one pre-registered retune (stall slope 3.0, Stage 0 on calibration seeds 905-909, the gate on fresh seeds 5-9 with the same alpha ladder). If it fails again, stop and report 'this world does not produce critic-caused harm from the missing common command'. BCA is never run.
stop_rule.room: No shifted situation room-certified: stop and report, with the cap-2 result, so the user can see whether BCA's dose range is the limit.
stop_rule.power: N > 20: stop as underpowered and report the smallest effect 20 seeds can detect.
stop_rule.seeds: Every pooled mark needs every seed. A failed seed fails the mark and is never dropped or replaced.

gate.alpha_rule: The alpha ladder rule (an amendment to the design, fixed before any outcome). H2 runs first at TD3+BC alpha 2.5. If H2 fails at 2.5, H2 is rerun at alpha 5, and if it fails there, at alpha 10. H1 uses fixed-controller critics and does not depend on alpha. The first alpha at which H1 and H2 both pass is used for H3, H4 and every later arm, the same for every arm. The choice never looks at any BCA output. Only if no alpha passes does the stall-slope 3.0 retune run, with the same ladder.

stop_messages.no_harm: This world does not produce critic-caused harm from the missing common command.
stop_messages.no_room: No shifted situation is room-certified: caution placed by the exact harm, inside BCA's dose range, does not beat even caution there, so no BCA result could be informative.
stop_messages.underpowered: Underpowered: more than 20 confirmation seeds would be needed.
stop_messages.ready: The gate passed. The BCA stage may be run on the room-certified situations if the user approves.

arm_text.flattened: BCA's doses spread evenly in each batch
arm_text.shuffled: BCA's doses shuffled within each batch
arm_text.noise_map: BCA's doses placed by the noise map
arm_text.matched_even: even caution matched in strength to BCA
arm_text.full_plain: plain TD3+BC on the full log
arm_text.band: BCA's band on the frozen plain critic

computed_in_design.T9: 9.5 (forecast with a critic that bends like the truth past 80%) / 40.4 (forecast with a critic that keeps its slope past the edge of the data)

code_names.plain: recorded conditions / strong current / big waves / big starting pushes
critic swap and caution placements (actor-only runs)

meta.nothing_trains: no critic, actor, cloning or BCA component is trained or imported (learners.py and acceptance.py are read as text only); every number is exact simulation of fixed controllers, the generated log, or arithmetic
